project.name: OEI Backend - Application
project.description: Compilation-time firewall against domain-core for every primary adapter module: any dependency here toward infrastructure-wiring (or another infrastructure module a primary adapter consumes directly) excludes domain-core from its transitive closure, while domain-core is reintroduced separately at scope=runtime. This guarantees no class in application-web (or any future application/* module) can import a concrete domain-core type at compile time — not even by IDE autocomplete mistake — while still letting Spring load/instantiate domain-core classes at runtime (OeiWiringConfiguration, in infrastructure-wiring, is the one place that constructs them). See the pattern this reproduces: the IAP platform's application/pom.xml (com.pictet.iap).
